description: This file contains deprecated SOAP API functions for SuiteCRM, including WSDL type definitions, session management, contact, lead, account, opportunity, case, bug, and email tracking operations. It defines external dependencies, core functions for validation, retrieval, creation, and search of CRM entities, and exposes symbols for external use.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Creates a new user session if credentials are valid.

methods.name: end_session
methods.description: Ends a user session.

methods.name: validate_user
methods.description: Authenticates a user by username and MD5 password hash.

methods.name: add_contacts_matching_email_address
methods.description: Adds matching contacts and linked beans to output list based on email.

methods.name: add_leads_matching_email_address
methods.description: Adds matching leads to output list based on email.

methods.name: get_contact_relationships
methods.description: Retrieves related modules for a contact by ID.

methods.name: contact_by_email
methods.description: Returns contacts and leads matching one or multiple email addresses.

methods.name: get_contact_array
methods.description: Converts a contact bean to an associative array.

methods.name: get_user_list_array
methods.description: Converts a user bean to an associative array.

methods.name: user_list
methods.description: Returns a list of users if authenticated.

methods.name: contact_by_search
methods.description: Searches contacts by name.

methods.name: get_lead_array
methods.description: Converts a lead bean to an array.

methods.name: lead_by_search
methods.description: Searches leads by name.

methods.name: get_account_array
methods.description: Converts an account bean to an array.

methods.name: account_by_search
methods.description: Searches accounts by name.

methods.name: get_opportunity_array
methods.description: Converts an opportunity bean to an array.

methods.name: opportunity_by_search
methods.description: Searches opportunities by name.

methods.name: get_bean_array
methods.description: Converts a generic bean to an array.

methods.name: get_case_array
methods.description: Converts a case bean to an array.

methods.name: bug_by_search
methods.description: Searches bugs by name.

methods.name: case_by_search
methods.description: Searches cases by name.

methods.name: track_email
methods.description: Records an email message and links it to related records.
